capabilities.title: Canonical project identity
capabilities.behavior: Canonicalize live project roots across aliases and platforms while preserving distinct worktrees and a recovery-only path for vanished roots.
acceptance: Equivalent live spellings converge.
Recovery identities cannot admit new durable state.

capabilities.title: Fenced single-writer leases
capabilities.behavior: Combine crash-released liveness with monotonically increasing epochs scoped by module, backend, and scope key.
acceptance: Live contention is refused.
A stale epoch cannot publish after replacement.

capabilities.title: Resolved storage descriptors
capabilities.behavior: Describe backend, isolation, least-privilege location, home resolution, and collision-safe database names without pulling database drivers into wire consumers.
acceptance: Descriptors carry no administrative credential.
Missing and relative homes remain explicit.

capabilities.title: SQLite store mechanics
capabilities.behavior: Open owner-protected SQLite stores under a lease, apply ordered migrations once, and surface store-ahead state.
acceptance: Migration chains reject duplicate or descending versions.
Fresh and reopened stores do not repeat seeds.

capabilities.title: PostgreSQL store mechanics
capabilities.behavior: Open pre-provisioned module databases, hold a session advisory lock, fence writes, and migrate by namespace.
acceptance: Connection loss releases liveness.
Slug-colliding module Ids derive distinct database names.

capabilities.title: Frozen-prefix cache policy
capabilities.behavior: Freeze final bytes on rebuild, replay them verbatim on defer, reconcile missing boundaries, and CAS the complete state.
acceptance: Deferred passes cannot render.
A full rebuild drains deferred work.

capabilities.title: Exact model catalog
capabilities.behavior: Parse provider capabilities, limits, modalities, raw additions, and exact tiered nanodollar prices without bundled data.
acceptance: Absent and zero prices remain distinct.
Nonzero prices cannot silently round to zero.

capabilities.title: Provider usage and capacity
capabilities.behavior: Represent quota windows, regeneration, breakdowns, balances, funding basis, account provenance, staleness, and in-band errors.
acceptance: Missing providers are not rendered as zero.
Healthy and degraded entries have unambiguous wire states.

capabilities.title: Encrypted push envelopes
capabilities.behavior: Seal bounded notification payloads in confidential or sender-authenticated HPKE envelopes with downgrade-safe opening.
acceptance: Authenticated opening uses a pinned full sender key.
Oversized plaintext is refused before encryption.

capabilities.title: Redacted fleet logging
capabilities.behavior: Format and parse canonical lines, filter hierarchical loggers, redact secrets, guard controls, retain append-only daily segments, and rotate single-writer captures.
acceptance: Secrets and control bytes cannot forge a log line.
Concurrent writers emit complete parseable daily lines.

capabilities.title: Message-plane traits
capabilities.behavior: Define digest-only messages, durable stream cursors, revisioned registers, bounded queues, census guards, dead letters, typed errors, and conformance properties.
acceptance: Every delivery has one recorded settlement path.
Dead-letter publication completes before terminal disposal.

capabilities.title: Deterministic in-memory bus
capabilities.behavior: Implement parity semantics for process-local streams, registers, queues, and permission-failure injection.
acceptance: Every parity property passes deterministically.
NATS-only properties are inapplicable, never passed.

capabilities.title: Bus topology and grants
capabilities.behavior: Derive six stream families, census names, durables, limits, and allow-only permissions from validated owner and principal tokens.
acceptance: Overlapping stream filters and escaping consumer filters are refused.
Participants cannot publish another principal's workload.

capabilities.title: NATS production bus
capabilities.behavior: Bind to provisioned NATS and JetStream resources with isolated inboxes, durable acknowledgements, revocation, and server-enforced grants.
acceptance: The client cannot create workload consumers.
NATS-only restart, rekey, revocation, leaf, and system properties pass.

capabilities.title: Real-process role harness
capabilities.behavior: Spawn on a fresh state root, route through the real module boundary, kill after one durable point, restart, and record kill evidence.
acceptance: One root and one kill are used per point.
Crash conformance cannot pass without a real process kill.

capabilities.title: Tool-provider contract
capabilities.behavior: Describe implementations, return deterministic catalogs, pin schemas and semantics, withdraw held work, and deliver acknowledged late results.
acceptance: Catalog and schema digests are deterministic.
Restart cannot auto-run pre-dispatch approval work.

capabilities.title: Tool-provider conformance
capabilities.behavior: Drive a live provider through real routes and approval crash points, reporting capability skips distinctly from passes.
acceptance: All declared-capability cases run.
Caller-only rules are checked against independently authored fixtures.

capabilities.title: Runner contract
capabilities.behavior: Define capability-gated transcript, run, stream, model-view, delivery, baseline, plan-change, hook, compaction, and tool attribution operations.
acceptance: Reads and events are lineage and cursor safe.
Send retries do not duplicate history or tool effects.

capabilities.title: Runner conformance
capabilities.behavior: Drive a live runner with scripted model and tool boundaries and verify role and crash guarantees through real routes.
acceptance: Every declared group runs its cases.
History, identities, terminal state, and dispatch remain valid after restart.

capabilities.title: Compaction-provider contract and conformance
capabilities.behavior: Define pure setup, bounded deltas, strict request fences, versioned half-open replacements, wait/ready, refusal, model view, and live-provider crash conformance.
acceptance: Late or superseded answers never apply.
Cursor, version, wait work, and setup purity survive real restart cuts.

capabilities.title: Step-transform contract and conformance
capabilities.behavior: Declare bounded hook subscriptions and enforce phases, operations, order, grants, questions, failure policy, purity, and crash recovery.
acceptance: Plans may tighten but cannot widen declarations.
A disallowed answer fails according to the frozen policy and cannot silently pass.
